items.title: Dozens arrested as violence mars Sydney rally against Herzog visit
items.description: Thousands of people attend protests across the country against Israeli President Isaac Herzog's visit to Australia in the wake of the Bondi terror attack, with demonstrators in Sydney sprayed with pepper spray and led away in handcuffs.

items.title: Ex-spy challenges ASIO's account of Bondi shooter's radicalisation
items.description: The former undercover agent spied on the Akrams when he infiltrated a Sydney IS terror cell for Australia's intelligence agency.

items.title: 'Untenable': Roblox on notice after child grooming reports
items.description: The government puts popular social gaming site Roblox on notice following media reports of children being approached and groomed by predators on the platform.

items.title: Angus Taylor faces push to launch leadership coup
items.description: Liberal leadership aspirant Angus Taylor is facing pressure from conservative supporters to challenge Sussan Ley this week and end the damaging speculation paralysing the party.

items.title: What does One Nation stand for?
items.description: One Nation questions if man-made climate change is real, wants to wind back access to abortion care, and plans to pay the HECS debts of doctors working in the regions.

items.title: Clouds gathering over Wall Street as AI disrupts the tech boom
items.description: Amongst tech investors the penny has finally dropped about just what the future may hold, and many are backing off or at least rethinking their strategy.

items.title: Live: Aussies Coady and Stalker miss the medals in big air final
items.description: Australian's Tess Coady and Mela Stalker miss the podium in the snowboard big air final, while Holly Harris and Jason Chan become the first Aussies in 12 years to represent the country in ice dancing. Follow live.

items.title: Ghislaine Maxwell will only talk if Trump grants clemency, lawyer says
items.description: The jailed accomplice of sex predator Jeffrey Epstein refuses to answer questions for the US Congress — but her lawyer says she will cooperate if granted clemency by the president.

items.title: These drugs are not going down to $25 under PBS script price changes
items.description: Painkillers, HRT therapies and incontinence medicines are among the drugs that will not benefit from the new maximum $25 script price.

items.title: New $220m plan to address violence against First Nations women and children
items.description: A national plan to tackle domestic violence against First Nations women was "hard fought for by Aboriginal women", an advocate says.

items.title: Government plans investment scheme crackdown after major funds collapse
items.description: The federal government plans a crackdown on managed investment schemes following the collapses of Shield Master Fund and First Guardian.

items.title: Commonwealth files defence against Linda Reynolds legal action
items.description: The Commonwealth files its defence against former senator Linda Reynolds, who is suing the government and its lawyers over a $2.4 million payout it made to Brittany Higgins.

items.title: Geoff Clark was jailed for fraud but questions persist for community
items.description: Former ATSIC leader Geoff Clark was jailed in 2024, yet some members of his community say legal issues linger on.

items.title: US seizes tanker in Indian Ocean that fled Caribbean blockade
items.description: The Pentagon says the vessel was operating in breach of Donald Trump's orders on sanctioned ships in the region.

items.title: King Charles will cooperate with police over any Andrew investigation, palace says
items.description: Police have confirmed they are assessing information provided to them that former prince Andrew had passed late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein confidential reports while the former royal was British trade envoy more than a decade ago.

items.title: Cyclone weakens to low in WA's north-west coast
items.description: The system is expected to weaken as it tracks farther south-east and moves inland through the Gascoyne region.

items.title: Quiz: Test your memory of the 2020s … so far
items.description: Today we're testing your memory of some of the major events of the 2020s in pop culture, sport and world news. Your challenge is to pick which happened first.

items.title: The 'insane' reality of raising a nine-year-old in Trump and ICE's Minnesota
items.description: What was once a hindrance is now "a paranoia like I've never known before", one Minnesotan man says, as his family hides from immigration agents.

items.title: Body corporates urged to be cautious after alleged strata fraud
items.description: The loss of $2 million from strata property accounts on the NSW Mid North Coast triggers concerns about the protection of shared assets.

items.title: First stage of Marinus Link approved but impact on bills unknown
items.description: The economic regulator has approved the first stage of the Marinus Link electricity connection between Tasmania and Victoria, and the associated transmission line, but it's not known what effect it will have on Tasmanians' power bills.

items.title: Native title holders appeal NT's largest groundwater licence in High Court
items.description: The cultural value of water will be front and centre in the High Court in Canberra today as a group of native title holders from Central Australia fight to assert cultural rights over an aquifer under their lands.

items.title: Luxury cruise ship being investigated after claims of 'horrifying' conditions
items.description: The maritime union says crew members of a luxury Carnival cruise ship allege they are being made to sleep in crowded rooms, lack access to safe free drinking water, and that some are earning as little as $2.50 an hour.

items.title: Scottish Labour leader calls for Starmer to resign
items.description: Keir Starmer is facing calls to resign after damaging revelations about the man he picked to represent the UK in Washington.

items.title: St Kilda star Max King injured again, Port ruckman's season over
items.description: Max King has suffered another injury, further frustrating the St Kilda key forward's bid for an AFL return.

items.title: Largest water users in the dark on a policy state governments urged to sign
items.description: As the country's state governments and territories consider signing a new national water policy that seeks to address climate change and elevate First Nations knowledge, the agriculture industry fears it has been overlooked.
